Ms Farrell's knee replacement (BK-551) is now on Thursday's 09:00 theatre list under Mr Adeyemi, with the side recorded as **right**.

One further step I'd recommend: the underlying booking record still shows "left", so please have the booking itself corrected and flag the discrepancy to Mr Adeyemi's team so it can be reconciled in the notes and at the pre-op check.
